description: Electric piano preset. Boxy scoop plus bell tine, gentle tube warmth. Spreads L/R when colliding with guitar.
name: elep-keys
notes: Precondition: Keys track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/elep-keys.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Tine boost / low-cut are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Send slot 0 -> small room FX (assign destination in Cubase one-time setup).
